name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog
description: CISA's authoritative source for vulnerabilities actively exploited in the wild. Federal agencies must remediate KEV vulnerabilities within specified timelines. 1,721+ entries as of Sept 2026.

peerReview.processDescription: Intelligence aggregation from government, industry, and OSINT. Validation through multiple sources. Vendor coordination. Public nomination. Federal agencies must remediate within 2-21 days.

attribution.attributionNotes: Federal authority. Mandates remediation across U.S. government. Public nomination process is transparent.
